question.text: Air inside a closed container is saturated with water vapour. The air pressure is \(\mathrm{p}\) and the saturated vapour pressure of water is \(\bar{p}\). If the mixture is compressed to one half of its volume by maintaining temperature constant, the pressure becomes

solution.text:
Hints: \(P_f=2 P+\bar{P}\)
Saturated vapour pressure will not change if temperature remains constant
